last.verdict: DraftKings cut its 2026 profit outlook from $700-900 million to $175-275 million to fund Predictions, and its 2027 profit guidance trails expectations.

takeaways.label: Profit forecast slashed
takeaways.text: 2026 adjusted profit is now $175-275 million, down from $700-900 million. Predictions spending of $650-700 million this year explains it. The core betting business is still guided to $875-925 million.

takeaways.label: 2027 below hopes
takeaways.text: 2027 profit is guided at $800 million to $1 billion, short of the roughly $1.12 billion analysts expected. Revenue is guided to $7.35-7.75 billion, up 17% at the midpoint.

takeaways.label: Predictions still a drag
takeaways.text: Predictions is expected to bring in $650-750 million of revenue in 2027, but it will cost $250-350 million more than it earns. It earned an immaterial amount in 2026.

takeaways.label: Core growth solid, losses widen
takeaways.text: Revenue rose 16% to $1.33 billion and monthly paying users rose 13% to 4.1 million. The adjusted loss still widened to $317 million from $127 million.

history.verdict: Investors looked past a revenue miss to strong user growth and unchanged full-year profit targets.

reasons.label: Surging customer growth
reasons.text: Monthly paying users rose 9% to 3.6 million, about 16% above expectations.

reasons.label: Guidance held
reasons.text: Full-year profit outlook stayed at $700-900 million; core business should earn about $1 billion.

reasons.label: Prediction markets momentum
reasons.text: New Predictions product has over 600,000 users and is growing faster than management expected.
